text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambia press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Ndola High Court yesterday ruled that United National Independence Party (UNIP) president Kenneth Kaunda was wrongly sued over his citizenship as the petitioners, Remmy Mushota and Patrick Katyoka should have applied for judicial review.
- Kenyan president Daniel Arap Moi said yesterday Africa would like to know who is backing Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila.
- Five heads of state yesterday arrived in Lusaka ahead of the Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa one day summit scheduled for this morning.

Arrested presidential petition witness Theresa Mulenga Kalo yesterday pleaded not guilty to a charge of unlawful possession of more than one national registration card purporting to show her identity.
